copy.title: ACT Landscape Construction — Landscaping, Pools & Sports Courts, Canberra
copy.description: Pools, sports courts, decks, walls, paving and gardens across Canberra and Queanbeyan, designed and built by one team from a Fyshwick showroom. 2025 Master Builders winner, Landscape Design and Construction Residential.
copy.headline:
Pool. Court.
Deck. Garden.
One team.
copy.sub: Xavier Duffy's team of 14 designs and builds whole backyards like this one, with every trade managed in-house. The one they built in Jerrabomberra won a 2025 Master Builders award.
copy.statementBody: No lining up a pool builder, a court company, a deck builder and a landscaper yourself. Design, approvals, excavation, construction and the final detail are all managed in-house, on our own mini excavators, tippers and skid steers. You deal with one team from the first conversation to handover.
copy.servicesIntro: Each part is planned around the rest: how the pool meets the paving and the deck, how a court sits into the levels and the drainage, how the planting ties it together. Built for Canberra's frosty winters and hot, dry summers.
copy.workIntro: A grass tennis court in Forrest, corten screens, a pool with its own spa, a courtyard plunge pool, a brick path through grasses, and a long pool in pale stone. Every photo on this page is one of our own jobs. Select any photo to see it larger.
copy.processIntro: The same six steps on every job, from the first call to walking you through the finished space.
copy.recognitionHeadline: Master Builders 2025. A showroom. One pool partner.
copy.recognitionIntro: Three things you can check before you ring.
copy.reviewsIntro: From our Google reviews, word for word. Two of the four run longer on Google and are marked shortened.
copy.areasIntro: From the showroom in Fyshwick, across Canberra, Queanbeyan and the surrounding areas. Recent jobs include a whole backyard in Forrest, retaining walls and paving in Kaleen, and the Jerrabomberra backyard that won at the 2025 Master Builders Excellence Awards.

process.detail: A quick conversation to understand your goals, ideas, budget and timeline. No pressure, just clarity, and a chance to see if we would be a good fit together.
We meet on site or virtually to assess the space and talk through what's possible, with honest advice tailored to how you live and use your outdoor area.
Design concepts, material selections, a scope of works and transparent pricing, so you know exactly what you're getting.
Once you're happy, we finalise approvals, confirm timelines and lock in your start.
Our in-house team builds it, with quality control and respect for your home the whole way through.
We walk you through the finished space and make sure every detail is right.

faq.q: What does a job like this cost?
faq.a: It depends on the size of your block, the scope of work and the materials you choose. We quote after an on-site consultation, with the design, materials, scope of works and pricing set out clearly, so you know exactly what you're getting.

We don't do quick patch jobs, low-cost shortcuts or one-size-fits-all packages. But it doesn't have to be a full property overhaul: a smaller upgrade is fine, and one of the reviews on this page is for a single retaining wall.

Yes. For pools we handle the required approvals and make sure the installation meets ACT regulations and safety standards. Some retaining walls need approval depending on their height and location, and we build to the local regulations.

faq.q: Can I see the materials before I commit?
faq.a: Yes. Book a time at the Fyshwick showroom to compare paving, stone, decking, pool coping and cabinetry finishes side by side, look at the pergola and outdoor kitchen displays, and go through your plans in the meeting room.

faq.q: Do you work on new builds?
faq.a: Yes. We work with homeowners, builders and developers on new builds, as well as renovations and complete backyard upgrades.
Yes. We operate with the licensing and insurance required for landscaping and structural outdoor works.
